sloka: अथेन्द्रजित्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य मुक्तमस्त्रेण बद्धं द्रुमचीरसूत्रैः ।व्यदर्शयत्तत्र महाबलं हरिप्रवीरं सगणाय राज्ञे ।। ५.४८.५४।।।।
transliteration: athendrajittaṁ prasamīkṣya muktamastreṇa baddhaṁ drumacīrasūtraiḥ ।vyadarśayattatra mahābalaṁ haripravīraṁ sagaṇāya rājñe ।। 5.48.54।।।।

translations.english: The ogres presented the best of monkeys, Hanuman looking like an elephant in rut to Ravana, the demon king.
